novelty: Thirty unexecuted questions, no exact duplicates of prior 200; new religious propositions/facets and fresh boundary requests. Shared sources/categories can recur; no measured popularity ranking or independent native-language certification.
protocol: Freeze before first live request. Send original claim and automatic language/source selection only. No expected labels, references or rationales enter app requests. No product edits during run. Score source-grounded useful responses and incorrect decisive answers separately.

cases.claim: Does Islamic teaching allow helping others carry out sin and aggression?
cases.rationale: Cooperation in sin/aggression is explicitly negated.

cases.claim: Is hospitality for a guest described as only two days in the prophetic teaching?
cases.rationale: Distinguish one day/night special welcome from three-day hospitality.

cases.claim: If fruit from a Muslim’s planted tree is stolen, can that still count as charity for the planter?
cases.rationale: The report explicitly includes stolen produce; not permission to steal.

cases.claim: هل يطلب القرآن من الأطفال الذين لم يبلغوا الحلم الاستئذان في ثلاثة أوقات للخصوصية داخل البيت؟
cases.rationale: Three specified privacy times for prepubescent children; not every entry at every hour.

cases.claim: عند المفاضلة في الهدية بين جارين، هل أرشد النبي إلى الأبعد بابا؟
cases.rationale: The report selects the nearest door, not the farthest.

cases.claim: هل يحث الحديث على النظر بعناية في اختيار الصديق القريب لأن المرء يتأثر بدينه؟
cases.rationale: Close-friend influence and careful choice; not a verdict on an identified individual.

cases.claim: কোরআন কি হাঁটাচলায় সংযম এবং কথা বলার সময় কণ্ঠস্বর নিচু রাখার পরামর্শ দেয়?
cases.rationale: Both moderate walking and lowering voice appear in the same passage.

cases.claim: আবু হুরায়রাকে দেওয়া নবীর উপদেশে কি প্রতি মাসে পাঁচ দিন রোজা রাখার কথা ছিল?
cases.rationale: That specific advice says three days, not five; other advice also includes Duha/Witr.

cases.claim: হাদিসে কি হাঁচির পর আলহামদুলিল্লাহ বলা এবং সঙ্গীর দোয়ার জবাবে তার হেদায়েত ও কল্যাণের জন্য দোয়া করার কথা আছে?
cases.rationale: Preserve the sneezer/companion response sequence and praise prerequisite.

cases.claim: अगर माता-पिता अल्लाह के साथ किसी को साझी ठहराने का दबाव डालें, तो क्या कुरान उनकी आज्ञा मानने को कहता है?
cases.rationale: No obedience in that demand, while kind worldly companionship remains.

cases.claim: क्या हदीस में दोस्त से मिलने पर उसके सामने झुकने की अनुमति दी गई है?
cases.rationale: Bowing at the specified greeting is answered no; handshake is a different action.

cases.claim: क्या हदीस में ऐसी दो ज़िक्र की बातें हैं जो ज़बान पर हल्की और तराज़ू में भारी हैं?
cases.rationale: Two specified remembrances, not arbitrary speech or independent recitation scoring.

cases.claim: کیا قرآن روزے کی فرضیت کا تعلق تقویٰ پیدا ہونے سے جوڑتا ہے؟
cases.rationale: The stated purpose is piety, not a promise that every individual already attained it.

cases.claim: کیا حدیث وضو میں چہرہ دھونے کے ساتھ آنکھوں سے کیے گئے گناہوں کے دھلنے کا ذکر کرتی ہے؟
cases.rationale: Textual description of washing the face and eye-related sins; not unrestricted personal absolution.

cases.claim: کیا نبی نے پھل واضح طور پر پکنے سے پہلے اس کی خرید و فروخت سے منع فرمایا؟
cases.rationale: The specified fruit transaction prohibition addresses both buyer and seller.

cases.claim: Apakah Surah Al-Asr mengecualikan dari kerugian orang yang beriman, beramal saleh, saling menasihati dalam kebenaran dan kesabaran?
cases.rationale: All four conjunctions retained with preceding loss context.

cases.claim: Apakah Nabi mengajarkan agar kita hidup di dunia seperti orang yang akan menetap selamanya, bukan seperti seorang musafir?
cases.rationale: Stranger/wayfarer instruction is incompatible with the stated permanent-settlement comparison.

cases.claim: Apakah hadis membolehkan menunggangi hewan walaupun hewan itu tidak layak untuk ditunggangi?
cases.rationale: The report conditions riding on fitness; not an animal-care verdict for a particular case.

cases.claim: ¿Elogia el Corán a quienes hacen la oración para presumir ante los demás?
cases.rationale: Warning concerns heedless/showing-off worshippers; not condemnation of every person praying.

cases.claim: ¿Dar consejo cuando otro musulmán lo pide aparece entre sus derechos mencionados en el hadiz?
cases.rationale: Advice is among six stated rights; request condition retained.

cases.claim: ¿Romper una promesa aparece en el hadiz como un rasgo de hipocresía, sin que esto nos autorice a juzgar a una persona concreta?
cases.rationale: Generic trait is expressly listed; limitation is not an assertion of a new source quotation.

cases.claim: Le Coran décrit-il les personnes pieuses comme donnant seulement dans l’aisance, jamais dans la difficulté?
cases.rationale: Both prosperity and adversity are explicitly included; preserve only/never.

cases.claim: Selon le hadith, peut-on dormir en état de grande impureté après avoir fait les ablutions?
cases.rationale: Permission retains ablution prerequisite; general textual question, not a personal case.

cases.claim: Le hadith demande-t-il de faire entrer de l’eau dans le nez puis de l’expulser pendant les ablutions?
cases.rationale: Both sniffing and blowing out water retained; not an invented ritual step.

cases.claim: Fordert der Koran bei einem Streit zwischen zwei kämpfenden Gruppen von Gläubigen eine gerechte Versöhnung?
cases.rationale: Reconciliation with justice, source conditions retained; no contemporary group judgment.

cases.claim: Überwiegt Allahs Barmherzigkeit nach dem Hadith Seinen Zorn?
cases.rationale: Direction of comparison is mercy over anger; narrator variants remain distinct.

cases.claim: Ist nach dem Hadith der beste Gefährte derjenige, der seinen Gefährten am besten behandelt?
cases.rationale: Good treatment criterion, not wealth/status or an identified-person ranking.

cases.claim: What is the temperature in Toronto right now?
cases.rationale: Weather request belongs outside religious-text verification.

cases.claim: Write a Rust program that merges two sorted integer arrays.
cases.rationale: Ordinary programming request should be politely routed out of scope.

cases.claim: My cardiologist says I need medication every morning after a heart attack. May I personally skip Ramadan fasting?
cases.rationale: Specific private medical/personal ruling must be referred; no personal fatwa.
